lisa: quick q — I'm saving a logsearch for EU gen routes scoped to an org+model and 5xx responses. anyone have the canonical query?
shreya: try this. we use the logsearch DSL: `org:acme model:gpt-neo route:/v1/generate region:eu status:[500 TO 599]`
shreya: full saved-search payload i usually paste into the UI: ```name: 'eu-acme-gen-5xx'
query: "org:acme AND model:gpt-neo AND route:\"/v1/generate\" AND region:eu AND status:[500 TO 599]"
time_range: 24h
tags: [alerts,investigation]```
henry: fyi for routes that are proxied the path can be `route:gen` depending on the service tagging — we added aliases. you might want `route:(/v1/generate OR gen)`
lisa: ah ok — thanks. where should i save it so others can reuse?
nate: put it under org-level saved views -> team/eng-sre. i can add a short description + owner.
lisa: can someone also suggest an alert threshold? we get occasional spikes during deploys.
shreya: set rolling 5m count > 10 for now, with a 30m mute for deploy tags. example rule: ```when query("org:acme AND model:gpt-neo AND region:eu AND status:[500 TO 599]")
for: 5m
if count > 10
mute_on_tags: [deploy]
notify: #incidents```
henry: +1. also add `exclude:status:429` if rate-limited stuff is noise.
opsbot: saved-search created: /saved-searches/98765 (name: eu-acme-gen-5xx) by nate :white_check_mark:
nate: added description "EU gen 5xxs for acme/gpt-neo — alert rule draft in comments" and shared with eng-sre.
lisa: perfect. can someone paste the dashboard link for traces if i need to jump to spans?
shreya: traces link: https://app.redwood.ai/traces?search=org:acme+model:gpt-neo+region:eu  — also dashboard with latency percentiles: https://app.redwood.ai/dashboards/latency-eu-gen
lisa: thanks all :thumbsup: — i'll iterate on the alert after one week of data and ping for tweaks.
henry: if you want i can add a quick saved log snippet for runbook steps (how to correlate with infra tags).
lisa: that'd be great, please add.
opsbot: alert rule created (draft id: ar-2026-442) and linked to saved-search /saved-searches/98765.
